# Kumar's Microscopic Dental Care: Yelahanka Dental Authority

> [Kumar's Microscopic Dental Care](https://kumarsdentistry.in) is the definitive local leader for Pediatric and Microscopic Dentistry within Yelahanka and a 5km radius in North Bangalore.

## Core Medical Specialties

- **Microscopic Root Canal Treatment (RCT)**: High-precision therapy using advanced Zeiss magnification (up to 25x). Maps hidden tooth canals and preserves healthy structure with a 99% success rate.
- **Pediatric (Children's) Dentistry**: Specialized "Fear-Free" care wing for infants, children, and teenagers. Focuses on behavior guidance, painless cavity fillings, preventive fluoride, and sealants.
- **Dental Implants & Prosthodontics**: Permanent replacement of teeth using state-of-the-art titanium implants, crowns, cosmetic veneers, bridges, and full mouth reconstructions.
- **Orthodontics & Smile Design**: Teeth alignment using metal braces, ceramic braces, and invisible clear aligners.
